table inet filter { # handle 1
	set blocked { # handle 4
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 1.2.3.4, 10.9.0.0/16 }
	}

	set webports { # handle 5
		type inet_service
		elements = { 80, 443 }
	}

	chain input { # handle 1
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state established,related accept # handle 6
		ct state invalid drop # handle 7
		iif "lo" accept # handle 8
		iifname "eth1" ip saddr 192.168.1.0/24 tcp dport { 22, 8000-8080 } accept comment "admin" # handle 10
		ip saddr @blocked drop # handle 11
		meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 53 accept # handle 13
		icmp type echo-request limit rate 5/second burst 5 packets accept # handle 14
		ip6 nexthdr ipv6-icmp icmpv6 type { echo-request, nd-neighbor-solicit } accept # handle 16
		tcp dport @webports counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "web " accept # handle 17
		iifname != "eth0" udp dport 123 reject # handle 18
		jump custom # handle 19
	}

	chain custom { # handle 2
		tcp dport 9999 accept # handle 20
	}

	chain forward { # handle 3
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy accept;
		oifname "eth0" ip6 daddr 2001:db8::/32 reject with icmpx admin-prohibited # handle 21
	}
}
table ip nat { # handle 2
	chain prerouting { # handle 1
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		iifname "eth0" tcp dport 8443 dnat to 192.168.1.10:443 # handle 3
		iifname "eth0" udp dport 5000-5010 dnat to 192.168.1.11 # handle 4
	}

	chain postrouting { # handle 2
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		oifname "eth0" ip saddr 192.168.1.0/24 masquerade # handle 5
		oifname "eth2" snat to 203.0.113.5 # handle 6
	}
}
